description: This file defines a utility class 'Debug' for configurable logging within the Apache OFBiz framework. It wraps log4j functionality to provide level-specific logging methods and controls for debugging and tracing various parts of the application.

classes.name: Debug
classes.description: A utility class providing configurable debugging and logging capabilities, wrapping Log4j for use within the OFBiz framework. Supports different log levels, dynamic toggling of logging, and formatted messages.

methods.name: getLevelFromString
methods.description: Returns an integer level corresponding to a string level name, or null if not found.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message with the specified level, throwable, module, calling class and parameters.

methods.name: isOn
methods.description: Checks if a specific logging level is enabled.

methods.name: verboseOn
methods.description: Checks if verbose logging is enabled.

methods.name: timingOn
methods.description: Checks if timing logging is enabled.

methods.name: infoOn
methods.description: Checks if info level logging is enabled.

methods.name: importantOn
methods.description: Checks if important level logging is enabled.

methods.name: warningOn
methods.description: Checks if warning level logging is enabled.

methods.name: errorOn
methods.description: Checks if error level logging is enabled.

methods.name: fatalOn
methods.description: Checks if fatal level logging is enabled.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Enables or disables logging at a specific level.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns whether logging at a specific level is enabled.
